name: QueryExcelWorksheetNode
label: Query Excel Worksheet
description: Executes a SQL query against an Excel worksheet using OLE DB and returns the result as a DataTable.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: WorkbookPath
fields.label: Workbook Path
fields.description: The file path of the Excel workbook to query.

fields.name: SqlQuery
fields.label: SQL Query
fields.description: The SQL query to execute against the Excel file. Use worksheet names like [Sheet1$] as table names.

fields.name: HasHeaders
fields.label: Has Headers
fields.description: Whether the first row contains column headers.

fields.name: QueryResult
fields.label: Query Result
fields.description: The result of the query as a DataTable.

fields.name: RowCount
fields.label: Row Count
fields.description: The number of rows returned by the query.
